study type: Feasibility study (quasi-experimental cohort with historical control)
exposure: Standard Positive Pressure Ventilation (historical control blinded from RFM measurements)
outcome: Proportion of breaths delivering goal tidal volume (4-6 ml/kg)
Proportion of breaths delivering low tidal volume (<4 ml/kg)
Proportion of breaths delivering high tidal volume (>6 ml/kg)
cohort: Preterm infants requiring invasive mechanical ventilation via endotracheal tube in the delivery room.
finding: Providing Volume Targeted-Positive Pressure Ventilation (VT-PPV) to intubated preterm infants in the delivery room is feasible and may result in an increased number of breaths delivered within the target tidal volume range.
